answer_1.quote: We present XCODEEVAL, the largest executable multilingual multitask benchmark to date consisting of 20M coding examples from about 7.5K unique algorithmic problems. It covers up to 17 programming languages with the parallelism of multilingual data. It features a total of 7 tasks involving code understanding, generation, translation and retrieval, and wherever appropriate it employs an execution-based evaluation protocol.

answer_2.quote: All of our proposed generative tasks are evaluated with execution-based unit tests by ExecEval.
